messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert - HIGH - runtime pods repeatedly segfaulting (SIGSEGV) in us-west-2-prod cluster. Incident created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-4567

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to @charlie.oncall (primary) and @anna.sre (secondary). Escalation policy: runtime-runtime-errors.

charlie.oncall: acked. I'm on it. First pass: checking pod state and recent deploys.

charlie.oncall: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-runtime -o wide`
```
# runtime-5f8c9d6d7b-xtq2  0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  6  5m  10.128.7.22  ip-10-0-3-12.us-west-2.compute.internal
# runtime-5f8c9d6d7b-bmcs  0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  6  5m  10.128.7.11  ip-10-0-3-11.us-west-2.compute.internal
```

charlie.oncall: `kubectl logs runtime-5f8c9d6d7b-xtq2 -n prod --previous` shows repeated SIGSEGVs. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:02Z runtime ERROR runtime_engine.cpp:412 segfault at 0 ip 0x7f2c1a3ea3 sp 0x7fff... code 0
#0  0x7f2c1a3ea3 in custom_kernel::fused_attention(...) + 0x13
#1  0x7f2c1a4a5b in runtime::forward(...) + 0x2b
```

charlie.oncall: Looks like signal 11 from the custom fused kernel path (vLLM/TensorRT custom op). No recent infra change in past hour per deploy bot.

anna.sre: I'll start node triage - possible node-level GPU driver anomalies. Pulling node logs and dmesg.

anna.sre: `kubectl describe node ip-10-0-3-12` shows repeated "NVRM: GPU page fault" and lines referencing tdriver 525.x. We might have a bad driver + kernel combo on that nodepool.

bob.runtime: pinged. I saw a few Canary failures in the last release where fused-kernel path regressed. Quick mitigation: disable custom fused kernels at runtime config to force pure host kernels. Env var: `USE_FUSED_KERNELS=false`.

bob.runtime: Suggested mitigation commands:
```
kubectl set env deployment/inference-runtime -n prod USE_FUSED_KERNELS=false
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n prod
```

charlie.oncall: Applying the env change to one replica set now to canary.

charlie.oncall: `kubectl patch deploy/inference-runtime -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"mitigation":"disable-fused-2026-03-15"}}}}}'`

charlie.oncall: Then `kubectl set env deploy/inference-runtime USE_FUSED_KERNELS=false -n prod` (applied). Rolling restart started.

incidents-bot: Mitigation in progress - 2/6 pods updated; target pods are coming up, older pods still CrashLoopBackOff.

anna.sre: Meanwhile I'm cordoning the two suspect nodes and draining them to avoid further restarts hitting the same hardware.

anna.sre: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-3-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> pods rescheduled to other nodes.

charlie.oncall: After drain + disable fused kernels, 4/6 pods are stable, 2 still failing (old node placements). Observed customer request latency spike ~+200ms.

lee-cs: Notified top tier customers via status page draft. Short blurb: "We're investigating intermittent runtime crashes affecting some production requests; mitigation underway. No data loss observed. We will update in ~30m."

bob.runtime: We should still collect cores from one failing pod for postmortem. Steps: create debug image with gdb, run `kubectl cp` to grab core, grab container image digest.

charlie.oncall: `kubectl exec -it runtime-5f8c9d6d7b-xtq2 -n prod -- ls -l /cores || true` -> no cores persisted. The container runtime strips cores. I'll enable core dumping on a single debug replica: set `ulimit -c unlimited` and mount a hostPath for /cores, then restart just one -> will reproduce.

dana.eng-ml: Eng-runtime joining. If it's fused kernel bug in TensorRT-LLM path, may need to pin to previous model-machine kernel or revert the small fused kernel optimization patch from last week.

bob.runtime: If disabling fused kernels fully mitigates, we can keep that flag while we prepare a proper rollback of the runtime image with the fix. Rolling back is risky during peak; prefer config toggle for immediate stabilization.

charlie.oncall: Current status: mitigation applied, majority of pods stable, customer latency normalizing. Moving to monitoring phase.

incidents-bot: Update: Severity -> partial-service-degradation. Keep incident open for root cause and postmortem.

anna.sre: I've promoted the drained nodes to a maintenance pool for repro later. Collected dmesg, nvml logs, and driver package info. Uploaded artifacts to the incident runbook: https://redwood.incidents/INC-4567/artifacts

bob.runtime: Eng-runtime will cut a revert branch and run CI + staged rollout to Dedicated before rolling to prod. ETA for revert PR + test: 3 hours.

lee-cs: Status page updated and customers informed. No active customer escalations yet. I'll keep CS on standby.

charlie.oncall: Handoff to eng-runtime for deeper debug. I'll remain available for SRE tasks and monitoring.

dana.eng-ml: Joining postmortem channel when ready. Request: include sample inputs, model name/version, image digest, and per-node nvml logs in artifacts.

charlie.oncall: Last update: 2026-03-15 18:25 UTC - System stable under mitigation flag. Leaving incident to eng-runtime for RCA. :white_check_mark:
